source: Theorem 4.6 / label th hybrid recall and its appendix restatement
exact_imported_claim: Theorem 4.6 constructs a three-layer hybrid model that achieves 99% accuracy on the associative recall task using embedding dimension O(max(log|V|, log L)) and window size tilde O(|V|).
distribution: A context of iid uniform word tokens from a power-of-two word vocabulary M, followed by exactly log2(|M|) bits encoding a query word; the query is uniform and independent.
failure_accounting: Contexts where the query word is absent are conservatively counted as failures because the source last-occurrence target is undefined.
assumptions: The word vocabulary size W is a power of two.
The bit subsequence has exactly log2(W) bits and decodes to a word token.
Non-bit context tokens are iid uniform over the W word tokens.
The desired output follows the last occurrence of the decoded query word.
pass_condition: Exact first-hit calibration reaches at least 0.99, the previous window remains below 0.99, and a certified three-layer construction retrieves the correct successor whenever the query is present.
falsification_condition: An in-distribution instance within the calibrated success event defeats the construction, or the minimum 99% window is not tilde O(|V|).
